DEMO ECSS-style standard. All text below is invented for testing and is not taken from any real standard.

5 Requirements
5.1 Software development plan
5.1.1 Plan content
a. The supplier shall produce a software development plan covering the full life cycle.
b. The software development plan shall identify the methods and tools used,
including the configuration management tool.
NOTE The plan can be merged with the project management plan.
5.1.2 Plan update
a. The supplier shall update the software development plan at each review milestone.
5.2 Verification
5.2.1 Unit testing
a. The supplier shall perform unit testing of all safety-critical software components.
NOTE 1 Coverage objectives are defined in ECSS-Q-ST-80 clause 6.3.5.
NOTE 2 See also NASA-STD-8739.8 for an equivalent approach.
b. Unit test results shall be recorded and kept under configuration control.
5.2.2 Code coverage
a. Statement coverage of 100 % shall be achieved for criticality category A software.
